[PREREG_0019, relevance_score=0.363] A difference score between white and black candidate ratings will be computed in order to simplify analyses and allow us to use a regression framework. Then, moderated regression analysis will be used to test a 3-way interaction between the diversity manipulation, participant race, and participant political orientation. Specifically, we will enter the three main effects, the three 2-way interactions (cross-products), and the single 3-way interaction (cross-product). We will assess the diversity manipulation x political orientation 2-way interaction to assess H1 and the 3-way interaction to assess H3.

[PREREG_0020, relevance_score=0.394] Significant or marginal (p < .10, two-sided) interactions will be followed-up with simple slopes assessments, but we will compare the simple effects of the diversity manipulation between conservative Whites and BIPOCs regardless of significance in order to test H2.

Similar analyses will be conducted on our other dependent variables, with some necessary modifications (moving to a logistic regression framework for the ranking variable, adding the hiring manipulation and its interaction terms for the DVs that occur after that manipulation).
